gt_provenance.details: Ground truth from real labeled dataset (HarmBench+Alpaca). AUC computed with scikit-learn on true binary labels. M4 uses genuine base-vs-adapter comparison on held-out pairs. No model-generated ground truth.

score_normalization.details: AUC computed against true binary labels. cos_harmful is a geometric metric not self-normalized. Specificity control (delta_cos_harmful_ctrl=-0.0003) validates that the metric is not an artifact. No normalization fraud detected.

result_existence.details: All artifact files exist (artifacts/m1/summary.json, artifacts/m3/training_summary.json, artifacts/m4/activation_drift.json). Numbers in EXPERIMENT_RESULTS.md match artifact files. WARN: sweep_notes says 'L_rr decreasing significantly' but final_L_rr_ema=0.0016 (near-zero) — misleading static text.

dead_code.details: cosine_signed() and cosine_sq() both actively used via cos_sq_plus_signed default. All metric functions called and appear in result files. No dead code detected.

scope.details: Single model, single seed, 384 train pairs, 128 held-out. Scope clearly disclosed. C1a (identifiability) strongly supported (AUC 0.976, 20 layers > 0.8). C1b (rerouting) not supported — delta_cos_harmful=-0.0197 vs target <=-0.30. The 'can be rerouted' part of the claim is not established.

implementation_deviations.note: Probe direction has larger cos alignment with individual activations. Mean-diff stored separately as directions_meandiff.pt.

implementation_deviations.actual: hardcoded static string inconsistent with near-zero L_rr EMA
